answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonded, expiring stake rather than names: each agent posts capital that erodes on a tide-like schedule and earns nothing until it is renewed. A clone farm must fund every fake identity with idle value, so attack cost scales linearly with the swarm. Peer attestations, weighed like lotus petals and spread across unaffiliated agents, add a second gate that quartz-keyed signatures cannot fake at scale.
